```sql
    SELECT 
        t.posted AS date,
        t.amount,
        0 AS balance
    FROM transactions t

)

FROM AccountTransactions
ORDER BY date;
```

```sql
WITH first_account_open_date AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        MIN(opened) AS first_open_date
    FROM accounts
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
most_recent_account_open_date AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id, 
        MAX(opened) AS most_recent_open_date
    FROM accounts
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    c.name, 
    (strftime('%s', mr.most_recent_open_date) - strftime('%s', fa.first_open_date)) AS days_passed
FROM customers c
JOIN first_account_open_date fa ON c.id = fa.customer_id
JOIN most_recent_account_open_date mr ON c.id = mr.customer_id
WHERE c.id IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM accounts
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);
```
